formats.key: payForSaleV2(bytes32 r_,bytes32 s_,uint8 v_,(uint256 price,uint256 cost,uint256 expiryTime,address destination,uint256 nonce,uint256 seriesID,uint16 quantity,(address recipient,uint256 bps)[] revenueShares,bool payByVaultContract) saleData_)
effects: The vault sends saleData_.price in ETH from its own balance to the signer (msg.sender).
The vault marks the signed sale message (chainid, signer, saleData_) as paid, so the same backend signature cannot be used again.
The call reverts unless payByVaultContract is true, the sale has not expired, the vault holds at least price, and the backend signer signed the data.
Nothing goes to destination or to the revenue share recipients in this call. cost, seriesID, quantity and revenueShares are only part of the signed hash.
formats.shown: "Pay for bulk artwork sale" with Price, Platform cost, a 'Recipient' that is the destination, Series ID, Quantity and revenue share recipients with their bps. This reads as if the signer pays the price to the destination.

findings.title: payForSaleV2 shows destination as 'Recipient', but the vault sends the price to the signer.
findings.evidence: FeralfileVaultV2.sol payForSaleV2: `payable(msg.sender).transfer(saleData_.price);` destination is used only in the signed hash `keccak256(abi.encode(block.chainid, msg.sender, saleData_))`. Descriptor: field `saleData_.destination` label "Recipient", field `saleData_.price` label "Price". Case 0 shows Price "0.5 ETH" and Recipient "Receiver".
findings.fix: Relabel destination as "Sale contract" (or "Destination") and change the price label to "ETH received from vault". Set the intent to "Receive vault ETH for artwork sale".

findings.title: payForSaleV2 intent 'Pay for bulk artwork sale' reads as the signer paying. The signer receives ETH instead.
findings.evidence: FeralfileVaultV2.sol payForSaleV2 is non-payable and only runs `payable(msg.sender).transfer(saleData_.price)`. Descriptor intent: "Pay for bulk artwork sale".
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Receive vault ETH for artwork sale" and add an interpolatedIntent: "Receive {saleData_.price} from Feral File vault for series {saleData_.seriesID}".

findings.title: payForSaleV2 shows Platform cost and revenue shares, but this call moves no funds for them.
findings.evidence: FeralfileVaultV2.sol payForSaleV2 reads only saleData_.payByVaultContract, price and expiryTime. cost and revenueShares go only into the signed hash. Descriptor: fields "Platform cost" (amount), "Revenue recipient", "Revenue share (basis points)".
findings.fix: Relabel these fields as sale terms, for example "Sale terms: platform cost" and "Sale terms: revenue recipient". Do not present them as payments in this call.

findings.title: payForSaleV2 test case 0 cannot succeed. It sends 0.5 ETH to a non-payable function with payByVaultContract false.
findings.evidence: cases/0.json input value "500000000000000000". The last tuple word (payByVaultContract) is 0, and the revenueShares array is empty. Code: `require(saleData_.payByVaultContract, ...)`. The function has no payable modifier.
findings.fix: Use value 0 and payByVaultContract true, and add at least one revenue share so the array fields render.

effects: Only the owner can call it. The vault sends weiAmount in ETH from its balance to the signer (msg.sender, the owner).
formats.shown: "Withdraw vault funds" with Amount 0.5 ETH. The signer receives this amount.

findings.format: payForSaleV2(bytes32 r_,bytes32 s_,uint8 v_,(uint256 price,uint256 cost,uint256 expiryTime,address destination,uint256 nonce,uint256 seriesID,uint16 quantity,(address recipient,uint256 bps)[] revenueShares,bool payByVaultContract) saleData_)
findings.title: payForSaleV2 shows destination as 'Recipient', but the vault sends the price to the signer.
findings.reason: The code is as quoted: the vault sends `price` to msg.sender (the signer) and `destination` only goes into the signed hash. But `payForSaleV2` is not payable, so nothing of the signer's leaves, and the only asset movement is ETH coming to the caller. Not-critical case 4 (funds that return to the caller, a payer or recipient that is the signer) covers this. The 'Recipient' label is misleading, but nothing is taken from the signer, so it is a warning at most.

findings.format: payForSaleV2(bytes32 r_,bytes32 s_,uint8 v_,(uint256 price,uint256 cost,uint256 expiryTime,address destination,uint256 nonce,uint256 seriesID,uint16 quantity,(address recipient,uint256 bps)[] revenueShares,bool payByVaultContract) saleData_)
findings.title: payForSaleV2 intent 'Pay for bulk artwork sale' reads as the signer paying. The signer receives ETH instead.
findings.reason: The function is not payable and moves no assets out of the signer's wallet. It only moves vault ETH to the caller, after `require(saleData_.payByVaultContract)`, so 'Pay for bulk artwork sale' names the vault paying for the sale. A careful signer loses nothing and gains no allowance or position, so this falls under the wording and intent cases of the not-critical list (10, and 4 for funds that come to the caller). It is a warning at most.
